Why choose us?

We make it easy for you to grow!

Proven Track Record

With over 20 years of experience in factoring, we’ve established a reputation for reliability and expertise. Our team has successfully supported businesses like yours, delivering consistent results and financial security.

Same-Day Funding

We understand the importance of timely access to funds. Once approved, you can count on us for same-day funding, ensuring your cash flow remains uninterrupted and your business stays on track.

Personalized Service

One of our Client Reps will work with you directly throughout the entire process for us, business is personal.

Non -Recourse

Our programs are truly non-recourse. When we approve your client, your money is guaranteed by us.

Industry Knowledge

We know your industry, and we’ll get to know your business to offer you the best deal possible with no hidden fees.

Alliances and affiliations

Factoring and Miami’s International Trade Success

Factoring and Miami’s International Trade Success

Miami has emerged as a thriving international trade hub, experiencing remarkable growth in import and export activities. With progressive legislation and a strategic location, Miami is poised to challenge New York’s status as the nation’s premier international finance center.

Factoring services have played a vital role in fueling Miami’s global trade success, and experts project double-digit growth for the industry in the coming decade. At Summar, we witness firsthand the transformative power of factoring services in streamlining and expediting cross-border transactions. We’re excited about the future of Miami’s international trade growth and are proud to be a part of it.
